title.zh: 消费者保护（符合性评估）条例 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 21 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Consumer Protection (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 1 July 2025.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

heading.en: Application for designation as CAB (Certification) or CAB (Testing)

text.en:
3.—(1) An application by a person to the Designating Authority to be designated as a CAB (Certification) or a CAB (Testing) must be made in accordance with the provisions of this Part.
(2) A person may apply to the Designating Authority to be designated as a CAB (Certification) to carry out one or both of the following:
(a)certify whether any product to be supplied in Singapore that is specified in the First Schedule to the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations conforms to the safety requirements specified by the Safety Authority under those Regulations;
(b)certify whether any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore conforms to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties.
(3) A person may apply to the Designating Authority to be designated as a CAB (Testing) to carry out one or both of the following:
(a)testing any product to be supplied in Singapore that is specified in the First Schedule to the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations for conformity to the safety requirements specified by the Safety Authority under those Regulations;
(b)testing any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore for conformity to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties.
(4) A person who, not being —
(a)a CAB (Certification) designated to carry out the certification mentioned in paragraph (2)(a); or
(b)a CAB (Certification — MRA),
issues a certificate of conformity for the purposes of the registration of any product under regulation 7(1) of the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations, shall be guilty of an offence.
(5) A person who, not being —
(a)a CAB (Certification) designated to carry out the certification mentioned in paragraph (2)(b); or
(b)a CAB (Certification — MRA),
certifies that any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore conforms to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties, shall be guilty of an offence.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES
PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

text.en:
5.—(1) An application for designation as a CAB (Certification) or CAB (Testing) must be made to the Designating Authority in the form that the Designating Authority determines.
(2) For the purposes of an application under paragraph (1) —
(a)the applicant must provide to the Designating Authority the documents and information that the Designating Authority requires; and
(b)the applicant must provide the Designating Authority, or any person that the Designating Authority may authorise, access to the laboratory or other premises of the applicant to enable the Designating Authority or that person to observe and assess the testing procedures of the applicant, as may be necessary.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

heading.en: Application fee, costs and expenses for designation

text.en:
6.—(1) The fee specified in the Second Schedule is payable together with an application mentioned in regulation 5 and is not refundable.
(2) Where the Designating Authority, or any person authorised by the Designating Authority, conducts any observation or assessment under regulation 5(2)(b), the Designating Authority may require the applicant to pay to it all reasonable costs and expenses incurred by the Designating Authority or that person in conducting the observation or assessment.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

heading.en: Approval of designation and issue of Certificate of Designation

text.en:
7.—(1) Upon receipt of an application under regulation 5, the Designating Authority may, in its discretion —
(a)approve the application, subject to any conditions that the Designating Authority thinks fit; or
(b)refuse the application.
(2) Where the Designating Authority approves an application under regulation 5, the Designating Authority must issue to the applicant a Certificate of Designation in the form that the Designating Authority determines.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

text.en:
8.—(1) Subject to these Regulations, the designation of a CAB is valid for a period of 3 years and may be renewed, subject to any additional conditions that the Designating Authority thinks fit.
(2) Unless the Designating Authority otherwise allows, an application for renewal of designation of a CAB must be made to the Designating Authority at least 6 months before the designation of the CAB expires.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

heading.en: Application of regulations 4 to 7 to renewal of designation

text.en: 9. Regulations 4 to 7 apply, with the necessary modifications, to a renewal of designation of a CAB.

chapter.en: PART 2 DESIGNATION OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES

text.en:
10.—(1) The Designating Authority must keep and maintain a register that contains the names and any particulars of the CABs, which are designated by the Designating Authority, that the Designating Authority may determine.
(2) Where —
(a)the designation of the CAB expires and is not renewed in accordance with regulation 8;
(b)the CAB applies to the Designating Authority for its designation to be withdrawn; or
(c)the designation of the CAB is suspended or withdrawn under Part 4,
the Designating Authority may remove the details of the CAB from the register or indicate against the details of the CAB in the register the fact of the expiry, suspension or withdrawal of designation.

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

heading.en: Information to be provided to Designating Authority

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

heading.en: Complying with request for conformity assessment or testing of products relating to conformity assessment without delay

text.en: 12. Where a CAB designated by the Designating Authority accepts a request to certify or test any product for conformity to the requirements for which it is designated, the CAB must carry out the request without delay, unless it has good reason for not doing so.

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

heading.en: CAB (Certification) to accept test conducted by CAB (Testing), etc.

text.en:
13.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), where a CAB (Certification) is requested to certify that a product conforms to the safety requirements specified by the Safety Authority under the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations, the CAB (Certification) must accept as correct a test report on that product issued by any CAB (Testing), CAB (Testing — MRA) or alternate testing laboratory.
(2) A CAB (Certification) must not cause another test to be conducted unless it has reason to believe that any test that was used to produce a test report mentioned in paragraph (1) was —
(a)improperly or incorrectly conducted; or
(b)conducted at a time when —
(i)the designation of the CAB (Testing) that conducted the test was suspended or withdrawn under —
(A)the Enterprise Singapore Board (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018 (G.N. No. S 686/2018) as in force before 1 July 2025; or
(B)these Regulations;
(ii)the designation of the CAB (Testing — MRA) that conducted the test was suspended or withdrawn by the country that designated it; or
(iii)the testing laboratory that conducted the test was no longer an alternate testing laboratory.

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

text.en:
14.—(1) A CAB (Certification) must maintain a technical file on every product that it certifies.
(2) A technical file maintained by a CAB (Certification) must include the documents and information specified by the Designating Authority and the CAB (Certification) must keep the technical file for a period of at least 10 years after the date of expiry of the last certificate of conformity issued by that CAB (Certification) for the product in respect of which the technical file is maintained.
(3) A technical file maintained by a CAB (Certification) that carries out certification of any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore for conformity to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties, must —
(a)include the documents and information required for the purposes of the relevant MRA; and
(b)be kept for the period of time required for the purposes of the relevant MRA.
(4) A CAB (Certification) must make available to the Designating Authority any technical file maintained by it within 7 days after receipt by the CAB (Certification) of a request from the Designating Authority for the technical file.
(5) A CAB (Certification) that contravenes any provision of this regulation shall be guilty of an offence.

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

text.en:
15.—(1) A CAB designated by the Designating Authority must, throughout the period of its designation, remain eligible for designation under regulation 4.
(2) A CAB designated by the Designating Authority must, throughout the period of its designation —
(a)maintain the standards of practice as are necessary for the CAB to properly carry out the certification or testing of products (as the case may be) to the relevant requirements for which the CAB is designated; and
(b)comply with the guidelines as to the standards of practice that the Designating Authority may, from time to time, issue.
(3) For the purpose of monitoring compliance with paragraphs (1) and (2), the Designating Authority may —
(a)conduct any surveillance assessment that the Designating Authority thinks fit; and
(b)require the CAB to participate in proficiency testing or any other comparison exercise that the Designating Authority may reasonably require.
(4) For the purposes of paragraph (3), the Designating Authority may require the CAB to pay to it all reasonable costs and expenses incurred by the Designating Authority in conducting any surveillance assessment.
(5) A person who obstructs the Designating Authority or any person authorised by the Designating Authority in the conduct of any surveillance assessment mentioned in paragraph (3)(a) shall be guilty of an offence.

chapter.en: PART 3 DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF CONFORMITY ASSESSMENT BODIES DESIGNATED BY DESIGNATING AUTHORITY

heading.en: Advertising by CAB designated by Designating Authority

chapter.en: PART 4 SUSPENSION AND WITHDRAWAL OF DESIGNATION

text.en:
17.—(1) The Designating Authority may withdraw the designation of a CAB where —
(a)the CAB ceases to carry on the business of conformity assessment or testing of products relating to conformity assessment for which the CAB is designated;
(b)the CAB fails or neglects to properly certify or test any product for conformity to the requirements for which the CAB is designated;
(c)the CAB has contravened, is contravening or is likely to contravene any provision of Part 3;
(d)the CAB is guilty of any offence involving fraud or dishonesty;
(e)the CAB has contravened, is contravening or is likely to contravene any condition imposed by the Designating Authority on its designation;
(f)the CAB is unable to properly certify or test any product for conformity to the requirements for which the CAB is designated;
(g)the CAB fails to pay to the Designating Authority any costs or expenses required under these Regulations;
(h)the CAB is for some other reason not fit to continue as a CAB designated by the Designating Authority; or
(i)in the case of —
(i)a CAB (Certification) designated to carry out any certification of any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore for conformity to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties; or
(ii)a CAB (Testing) designated to carry out any testing of any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore for conformity to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties,
the relevant MRA so requires.
(2) Where the Designating Authority is satisfied that any ground for withdrawing the designation of a CAB exists —
(a)the Designating Authority must notify the CAB in writing and must specify, in that notification —
(i)the ground entitling the Designating Authority to withdraw the designation of the CAB; and
(ii)a period (of at least 14 days) within which the CAB may provide to the Designating Authority any explanation it may wish to offer and to inform the Designating Authority if it wishes to be heard; and
(b)the designation of the CAB is suspended as from the date of that notification.
(3) After considering any explanation of the CAB and after providing the CAB with a reasonable opportunity to be heard under paragraph (2), the Designating Authority —
(a)may make any of the following decisions:
(i)subject to any conditions that the Designating Authority thinks fit, lift the suspension on the designation of the CAB;
(ii)withdraw the designation of the CAB; and
(b)must notify the CAB in writing of its decision.
(4) A person whose designation as a CAB (Certification) has been suspended or withdrawn must not, during the period of the suspension or starting on the date of the withdrawal, as the case may be —
(a)issue any certificate of conformity for the purposes of the registration of any product under regulation 7(1) of the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations; or
(b)certify that any product to be supplied in a country other than Singapore conforms to the applicable requirements specified in an MRA to which both Singapore and that country are parties.
(5) A CAB (Certification) that contravenes paragraph (4) shall be guilty of an offence.
(6) For the purposes of this regulation, the Designating Authority may require any person whom the Designating Authority believes to have knowledge of a matter —
(a)to produce for inspection any book, document, paper or other record relating to or connected with the matter; and
(b)to give any information relating to or connected with the matter that the Designating Authority may require.
(7) For the purposes of paragraph (1)(d), the Designating Authority may accept the conviction of the CAB as final and conclusive.
(8) The Designating Authority may require the CAB concerned to pay to it any costs and expenses of and incidental to any inquiry conducted under this regulation that the Designating Authority thinks fit.
(9) Where the provisions of an MRA require the suspension or withdrawal of the designation of a CAB (Certification) or CAB (Testing) to carry out certification or testing of any product to be supplied in a country that is a party to the MRA, then this regulation applies with any modifications that may be necessary to enable those provisions to be complied with.

18. A person who is guilty of an offence under regulation 3(4) or (5), 11(4), 14(5), 15(5) or 17(5) shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or to both.

19.—(1) Any agreement that was an approved testing agreement as defined in regulation 2 of the revoked Regulations immediately before the specified date is on and after that date treated as an approved testing agreement as defined in regulation 2(1) of these Regulations.
(2) Where an application to be designated as a CAB (Certification) made under regulation 5 of the revoked Regulations is pending immediately before the specified date, the application is on and after that date treated as an application to be designated as a CAB (Certification) under regulation 5 of these Regulations.
(3) Where an application for renewal of designation as a CAB (Certification) made under regulation 5 (as applied by regulation 9) of the revoked Regulations is pending immediately before the specified date, the application is on and after that date treated as an application for renewal of designation as a CAB (Certification) under regulation 5 (as applied by regulation 9) of these Regulations.
(4) Where an application to be designated as a CAB (Testing) made under regulation 5 of the revoked Regulations is pending immediately before the specified date, the application is on and after that date treated as an application to be designated as a CAB (Testing) under regulation 5 of these Regulations.
(5) Where an application for renewal of designation as a CAB (Testing) made under regulation 5 (as applied by regulation 9) of the revoked Regulations is pending immediately before the specified date, the application is on and after that date treated as an application for renewal of designation as a CAB (Testing) under regulation 5 (as applied by regulation 9) of these Regulations.
(6) A person who, immediately before the specified date, was a CAB (Certification) as defined in regulation 2 of the revoked Regulations, is on and after that date deemed to be a CAB (Certification) under these Regulations for the remaining period of the person’s designation as such, subject to any condition to which that designation was subject immediately before that date.
(7) Regulation 11(1) applies to a person mentioned in paragraph (6) in relation to any document or information mentioned in regulation 11(1) in connection with its business of conformity assessment carried on before the specified date (including any evidence of participation in proficiency testing or any other comparison exercise mentioned in regulation 15(3)(b) of the revoked Regulations), as it applies to that document or information in connection with that business carried on by that person on or after that date.
(8) A person who, immediately before the specified date, was a CAB (Testing) as defined in regulation 2 of the revoked Regulations, is on and after that date deemed to be a CAB (Testing) under these Regulations for the remaining period of the person’s designation as such, subject to any condition to which that designation was subject immediately before that date.
(9) Regulation 11(1) applies to a person mentioned in paragraph (8) in relation to any document or information mentioned in regulation 11(1) in connection with its business of testing carried on before the specified date (including any evidence of participation in proficiency testing or any other comparison exercise mentioned in regulation 15(3)(b) of the revoked Regulations), as it applies to that document or information in connection with that business carried on by that person on or after that date.
(10) Any notification given by a person mentioned in paragraph (6) or (8) under regulation 11(2) or (3) of the revoked Regulations before the specified date is treated as having been given under regulation 11(2) or (3) of these Regulations, respectively.
(11) Regulation 14 applies to a person mentioned in paragraph (6) in relation to a product that it certified before the specified date, as it applies to that person in relation to a product that it certifies on or after that date, except that the period for which the technical file for the product is to be maintained under regulation 14(2) or (3) (as the case may be) is substituted with the unexpired period for which the technical file is to be maintained under regulation 14 of the revoked Regulations.
(12) Any request given by the old Designating Authority under regulation 14(4) of the revoked Regulations before the specified date is on and after that date treated as having been given by the Designating Authority under regulation 14(4) of these Regulations and must be complied with before the expiry of the 7‑day period mentioned in regulation 14(4) of the revoked Regulations.
(13) Regulation 17(1) and (2) applies to a person mentioned in paragraph (6) or (8) in relation to any ground mentioned in regulation 17(1) that arose before the specified date, as it applies to that person in relation to any such ground that arises on or after the specified date, with the following modifications:
(a)the reference in regulation 17(1)(a) to the business of conformity assessment or testing of products relating to conformity assessment for which the person is designated includes the business for which the person was designated under the revoked Regulations;
(b)the reference in regulation 17(1)(b) and (f) to the requirements for which the person is designated includes the requirements for which the person was designated under the revoked Regulations;
(c)the reference in regulation 17(1)(c) to any provision of Part 3 includes any provision of Part 3 of the revoked Regulations;
(d)the reference in regulation 17(1)(e) to any condition imposed by the Designating Authority on the person’s designation includes any condition imposed by the old Designating Authority on the person’s designation under the revoked Regulations;
(e)the reference in regulation 17(1)(g) to a failure to pay the Designating Authority any costs and expenses required under these Regulations includes a failure to pay the old Designating Authority any costs and expenses required under the revoked Regulations.
(14) Paragraph (15) applies where —
(a)the old Designating Authority had under regulation 17(2) of the revoked Regulations given a person mentioned in paragraph (6) or (8) a reasonable opportunity to be heard against the withdrawal of a designation under the revoked Regulations; and
(b)either of the following applies:
(i)the time period mentioned in regulation 17(2)(a)(ii) of the revoked Regulations had not expired before the specified date;
(ii)the time period mentioned in regulation 17(2)(a)(ii) of the revoked Regulations had expired before the specified date but the old Designating Authority had not before the specified date, notified the person in writing of its decision under regulation 17(3) of the revoked Regulations.
(15) The Designating Authority is treated as having given the person mentioned in paragraph (14) a reasonable opportunity to be heard under regulation 17(2) of these Regulations and the Designating Authority may —
(a)where paragraph (14)(b)(i) applies, upon the expiry of the time period mentioned in regulation 17(2)(a)(ii) of the revoked Regulations, deal with the person in accordance with regulation 17(3) of these Regulations; and
(b)where paragraph (14)(b)(ii) applies, deal with the person in accordance with regulation 17(3) of these Regulations.
(16) Where a person’s designation as a CAB (Certification) or CAB (Testing) is suspended or withdrawn under regulation 17 of the revoked Regulations as at the date immediately before the specified date, the suspension or withdrawal continues on and after the specified date as if it were a suspension or withdrawal (as the case may be) of the person’s designation as a CAB (Certification) or CAB (Testing) (as the case may be) under regulation 17 of these Regulations.
(17) In this regulation —
“old Designating Authority” means the Designating Authority as defined in regulation 2 of the revoked Regulations;
“revoked Regulations” means the Enterprise Singapore Board (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018 as in force immediately before the specified date;
“specified date” means 1 July 2025.
